summary: Backend fully functional (12/12 pytest passing incl. Claude Sonnet 5 SOAP JSON output, Whisper endpoint compiles). Frontend blocked: guest-signin-btn on /auth/login does NOT authenticate — URL stays on /auth/login after multiple taps, tabs never load. Backend /api/auth/guest itself works correctly via curl/pytest, so this is a frontend integration bug.

ui_bugs.issue: Tap on 'Essayer en tant qu'invité' (testID=guest-signin-btn) on /auth/login does not perform sign-in. URL stays at /auth/login, no navigation to (tabs). Backend POST /api/auth/guest works — verify that the handler awaits api call, stores session_token in AsyncStorage/context, and calls router.replace('/(tabs)'). Onboarding CTA correctly forwards to /auth/login but the login-screen guest button is broken.

integration_issues.issue: Cannot reach any tab because guest login on /auth/login is broken. context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend BASE_URL=https://doctor-assistant-12.preview.emergentagent.com uses env var EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL (NOT EXPO_BACKEND_URL). Backend fully green. Frontend guest login broken — this is the single blocker. After main agent fixes app/auth/login.tsx onPress handler for guest-signin-btn, rerun the same Playwright script (navigate root → click onboarding-next-btn twice → click guest-signin-btn → expect URL contains /(tabs) or / and testID=tab-home visible).
rca_of_issue: Reproduction: 1) open https://doctor-assistant-12.preview.emergentagent.com 2) tap onboarding-next-btn twice 3) tap guest-signin-btn — URL becomes /auth/login (login screen renders with same buttons) 4) tap guest-signin-btn again — URL still /auth/login, no tab UI. Backend POST /api/auth/guest returns 200 with session_token via curl. Root cause is client-side: login screen's guest handler is not awaiting the API response and/or not persisting session before navigation, so the auth guard immediately redirects back to /auth/login. Suggested fix: `const { token, user } = await api.guestLogin(); await setSession(token, user); router.replace('/(tabs)');` — ensure setSession updates AsyncStorage and context state synchronously, and verify AuthProvider's redirect logic reads the updated state.
